## Data sources

This is the IVU data

```{r}
#| label: air_pollution
airpoll_folder<-"N:/4all.i4/I4.10 - Projekte/Luftschadstoffkartierung/Ergebnisse/ergebnisse_vorbelastung_2019/"
shp_files <- list.files(path = airpoll_folder, pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)

print(shp_files)

no2<-shp_files[2] |> 
  sf::st_read()

pm25<-shp_files[6] |> 
  sf::st_read()

pm25 |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(color = MEAN)) + 
  scale_colour_viridis_c("PM2.5 [µd/m³]")
```
